types.name: Gross–microscopic mismatch
types.definition: size, number, laterality or site in the gross contradicted in microscopy or synoptic.

types.name: Diagnosis unsupported by morphology
types.definition: microscopic description does not support the stated diagnosis or grade.

types.name: Staging inconsistency
types.definition: pT/pN contradicts reported size, depth of invasion or node findings.

types.name: Node arithmetic error
types.definition: positive nodes exceed total, or text and synoptic counts differ.

types.name: Required element missing or contradictory
types.definition: margins, LVI or PNI absent, or margin status contradicts the description.

types.name: Derived-index inconsistency
types.definition: MCV, MCH or MCHC inconsistent with Hb, RBC and Hct; differential not summing to 100; absolute counts inconsistent with WBC.

types.name: Missed critical finding
types.definition: a critical value or finding with no flag, comment or recommendation.
